findings.claim: The change adds a new backend module, backend/app/services/mtime.py, that the touch-point list does not name. Every write path and the scanner now depend on it.
findings.impact: No user impact. A reader who checks the touch points against the code will not find the single helper that defines how st_mtime is truncated and stored. That helper is where I1, I2 and I14 can break.
findings.evidence: backend/app/services/mtime.py:8-17 defines modified_at_from_stat and read_modified_at. They are imported at scanner.py:38, content_write.py:11, upload.py:25, fileops.py:29, markdown_relations.py:23 and drives.py:60. The touch points list scanner, content_write, upload, fileops, drives and markdown_relations, but not mtime.py.
findings.repro: Compare the product file list with the Touch points section: mtime.py is the only new backend product file and it appears in neither the Core nor the Addon list.

bucket_proposal.reason: No invariant breaks; the list is incomplete.

findings.proposed_fix: Add backend/app/services/mtime.py to the spec's Core touch points as the shared whole-second mtime helper.

findings.claim: The menu's first-level order (Modified between Length and Favorites) is set in frontend/src/components/search/SearchQueryHeader.tsx, which the touch-point list does not name. The list names only ConditionMenu.tsx and SearchFilterChips.tsx.
findings.impact: If the entry were left out of SearchQueryHeader's entries array, the 「更新日」 menu entry would not appear on the results page, even though ConditionMenu supports it. The touch-point list would not have directed anyone to this file. The two existing first-level-order tests were updated and would catch that omission.
findings.evidence: SearchQueryHeader.tsx:272-281: the entries array now includes "modified" between "duration" and "favorite". The touch points name only `frontend/src/components/search/ConditionMenu.tsx` and `SearchFilterChips.tsx`.
findings.repro: Remove "modified" from the entries array at SearchQueryHeader.tsx:279. SearchQueryHeader.modified.test, .scope.test and .sizeDuration.test, which assert the eight-entry order, would fail; nothing in the touch-point list points at this file.

bucket_proposal.reason: The behaviour is correct and tested; only the planned list misses the file.

findings.proposed_fix: Add frontend/src/components/search/SearchQueryHeader.tsx (the `entries` list) to the touch points next to ConditionMenu.tsx.

findings.claim: A test fixture for a SmartFolder (saved Smart Collection) row gains `modified_at: null`. The SmartFolder type has no such field, so the bulk FileItem fixture edit reached a non-FileItem literal.
findings.impact: No runtime impact: the object is untyped and the extra key is ignored. A reader could take it as a sign that Smart Collections carry a modification time and add one to the SmartFolder type.

findings.claim: read_modified_at catches only OSError. datetime.fromtimestamp raises ValueError or OverflowError for an mtime beyond the platform or datetime range. That conversion now runs for every existing row the scan walks in pass 1, so one file with such an mtime aborts the whole scan.
findings.impact: With a file whose mtime lies after year 9999 (an archive with corrupt timestamps, a broken camera clock), a drive scan that previously finished now raises in pass 1, and none of the drive's changes are recorded.
findings.evidence: mtime.py:8-17: the conversion in modified_at_from_stat is not inside the try, and read_modified_at's try covers only os.stat. scanner.py:585 calls read_modified_at(item) for every existing walked row with no surrounding handler. Pass 2 (scanner.py:654-662) already had an unguarded datetime.fromtimestamp for new files, so new files were already exposed; existing rows are newly exposed.

bucket_proposal.reason: Needs a filesystem timestamp far outside normal use, outside the declared threat model's normal use; no invariant names it.

findings.proposed_fix: In read_modified_at and at the scanner's pass-2 stat, treat ValueError/OverflowError from the conversion as a failed stat (return None).

specification_compliance: Scope question answer: product places reached but not in the touch-point list are backend/app/services/mtime.py (SCOPE-1), frontend/src/components/search/SearchQueryHeader.tsx (SCOPE-2) and the five e2e/preview fixtures (SCOPE-3). Frontend and MCP test directories are also unlisted (SCOPE-4). Spec, INDEX.md and docs/process/reviews files are implicit and not reported.

Listed touch points that the diff does not change: frontend/src/lib/api.ts, FileDetailFullScreen.tsx, SmartFolderSaveButton.tsx, readingAppTarget.ts and VideoAppHeader.tsx. api.ts reaches `modified` through listingRequest.appendListingFilters for GET, POST /files/query and the shelves builder (api.ts:180, listingRequest.ts:79-91, 103-104). readingAppTarget is covered via resolveAppTarget (appTarget.ts:97). The other callers use evaluateSmartCollection with no timeZone, which means the browser zone.
Server-side Smart Collection evaluation builds its listing through listingUrl (smartCollectionServerIo.ts:60), so `modified` reaches the backend on that path too.
The .claude/rules/internal-api-policy.md row 15 note and the docs (api.md, ADDON-DEVELOPMENT.md, intelligence.md, user-guide/search.md) are in the touch points and are reached.
Addon submodule pointer bump to 487c6b8 is listed ("its own PR, then the pointer bump").
potential_unspecified_behavior: useFolderFiles keys one search run's `now` to the query text plus the type filter (useFolderFiles.ts:183-187). Re-submitting the identical query, or a refreshKey change, does not take a new `now`, so relative bounds stay at the first submission's instant until the text changes.
The route treats an empty `tz=` as absent (route.ts:52), so `tz=` with an absolute date answers 400 "tz is required" rather than "Unknown time zone".
regression_risks: The commit subject says it points intelligence "at the modified filter branch for review". Whether 487c6b8 is reachable from the addon's default branch was not verified. If it is not, the pointer bump could reference an unmerged addon commit, contrary to sending step 6.
Scanner pass 1 now stats and converts every walked file's mtime; an unconvertible mtime aborts the scan (ROBUST-1).

_write_modified_at_only issues an ORM-enabled UPDATE with synchronize_session="fetch" per changed row. The upgrade backfill therefore runs one extra UPDATE plus a fetch per existing row on the first scan; on a large drive this adds scan time inside the scan lock.
test_coverage: I19's third clause (a build from before this change opens the migrated database and lists files) has no test; only the column add and idempotence are tested (test_file_modified_at.py TestMigration).
No test covers a scan of a file whose mtime cannot be converted to a datetime.

The POST /files/query path's `modified` parameter is exercised in backend parity tests (TestSurfaceParity). The frontend POST builder is tested only indirectly through useFileSearch mocks, not through listingQueryUrl's URL.
SearchQueryHeader's eight-entry order is pinned by three tests, so dropping the entry from SearchQueryHeader.tsx would be caught.
not_verified: No tests were run (read-only review); pass/fail of the new backend, frontend, MCP and addon tests is not known.
Whether addons/intelligence commit 487c6b8 is on the addon repository's default branch.
The 375 px layout of the menu and chip (R-5 measured at 338 px only, per decisions.md).
TypeScript compilation of the whole frontend, e.g. that ConditionMenu's choose() accepts "modified" as an operator.
Behaviour of SQLite string comparison for modified_at values written outside the ORM (only tests do that).

perspectives.notes: Compared every product path in the diff against the declared touch points. Unlisted: mtime.py, SearchQueryHeader.tsx, the five e2e/preview fixtures, and the frontend and MCP test directories. Listed touch points not changed in the diff were checked to be reached indirectly.

perspectives.name: submodules
perspectives.notes: The addon pointer moves 6e85c9c→487c6b8. The addon's SearchFilter.modified validator mirrors the core's parse_modified_comparison: same regex, same max and dedup-then-cap order. Branch reachability was not verified.

perspectives.name: persistence
perspectives.notes: The migration adds a nullable column idempotently. ORM writes store naive UTC whole seconds and comparisons bind naive UTC datetimes, so formats match. The scanner's modified-only write keeps updated_at by assigning it to itself.

perspectives.name: concurrency
perspectives.notes: The scan runs under the existing scan lock. The ORM-enabled UPDATE autoflushes pending changes first, so any updated_at bump comes from the ORM's own flush of a real change. One `now` per run is held in a ref; `in:` resolution reuses the run's `now` (revised I18).
